Wes Moore Speaks as Maryland Marks 2 Years Since Francis Scott Key Bridge Collapse More (0) » Forecast DC Forecast: Some morning clouds Saturday, breezy and a bit cool More sunshine Sunday and a bit milder. Credit: WUSA9 Weather Author: Jonathan Myers, Topper Shutt, Kaitlyn McGrath, Makayla Lucero, Miri Marshall Published: 5:41 AM EST March 7, 2025 Updated: 6:16 AM EST March 8, 2025 WASHINGTON — Sunday is the pick of the weekend with milder temperatures and less wind. Three Things To Know: Isolated showers overnightBreezy SaturdaySunshine both weekend days RELATED: Forecast: Saturday: Becoming partly sunny and breezy. Highs: 51 - 56. Winds: NW 10 - 15.Saturday Night: Clear and cold. Lows: 25 - 35. Winds: NW 10.Sunday: Mostly sunny and stellar. Highs: 55 - 60. Winds: SW 10. Weather Conversation: Saturday will start off with clouds before skies clear throughout the day. Temperatures will be seasonably cool in the low to mid 50s, but with a gusty wind it will feel more like the 40s. Sunday is the pick day of the weekend with less wind and milder temperatures in the upper 50s.
